test.create_query: CREATE RESOURCE perf_cpu_scheduling (MASTER THREAD, WORKER THREAD)
CREATE WORKLOAD perf_cpu_scheduling_wide IN perf_cpu_scheduling_all SETTINGS max_concurrent_threads = 64
CREATE WORKLOAD perf_cpu_scheduling_narrow IN perf_cpu_scheduling_all SETTINGS max_concurrent_threads = 4
CREATE WORKLOAD perf_cpu_scheduling_mixed IN perf_cpu_scheduling_all SETTINGS max_concurrent_threads = 1
CREATE TABLE perf_cpu_scheduling_set (key UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY key
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_cpu_scheduling_set SELECT number, hex(SHA256(toString(number))) FROM numbers(18500)
SELECT number % 1000000 AS k, count(), sum(number) FROM numbers_mt(200000000) GROUP BY k SETTINGS workload = '{workload}', log_comment = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_probe' FORMAT Null

SELECT max(rn) FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY h) AS rn FROM (SELECT cityHash64(number) AS h FROM numbers_mt(10000000))) SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_wide', log_comment = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_probe'

SELECT number % 100000 AS k, count() FROM remote('127.0.0.{{2,3}}', numbers_mt(80000000)) GROUP BY k SETTINGS async_socket_for_remote = 1, max_threads = 1, workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_wide', log_comment = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_probe' FORMAT Null

SELECT count() FROM perf_cpu_scheduling_set WHERE NOT ignore(s) SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_mixed_io', max_threads = 1, max_local_read_bandwidth = 1000000, max_read_buffer_size_local_fs = 4096, local_filesystem_read_method = 'read', log_comment = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_probe'

SELECT throwIf(count() < 5 OR countIf(parks = 0) > 0, 'workload_cpu_scheduling: an SQL item does not take its CPU slots from its workload or does not park'), throwIf(maxIf(peak, query LIKE '%sum(number)%perf_cpu_scheduling_narrow%') >= maxIf(peak, query LIKE '%sum(number)%perf_cpu_scheduling_wide%'), 'workload_cpu_scheduling: the narrow workload does not limit the threads of its query') FROM (SELECT query, argMax(ProfileEvents['ConcurrencyControlParks'], event_time_microseconds) AS parks, argMax(peak_threads_usage, event_time_microseconds) AS peak FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND type = 'QueryFinish' AND is_initial_query AND log_comment = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_probe' GROUP BY query)
test.query: SELECT number % 1000000 AS k, count(), sum(number) FROM numbers_mt(200000000) GROUP BY k SETTINGS workload = '{workload}' FORMAT Null
SELECT max(rn) FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY h) AS rn FROM (SELECT cityHash64(number) AS h FROM numbers_mt(10000000))) SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_wide'

SELECT number % 100000 AS k, count() FROM remote('127.0.0.{{2,3}}', numbers_mt(80000000)) GROUP BY k SETTINGS async_socket_for_remote = 1, max_threads = 1, workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_wide' FORMAT Null

SELECT count() FROM perf_cpu_scheduling_set WHERE NOT ignore(s) SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_mixed_io', max_threads = 1, max_local_read_bandwidth = 1000000, max_read_buffer_size_local_fs = 4096, local_filesystem_read_method = 'read'

W_ID="perf_cpu_scheduling_neighbour_$$_${RANDOM}" W_ERR="$(mktemp)" C_ERR="$(mktemp)" W_PID="" cleanup() { if [ -n "$W_PID" ]; then $CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT --query "KILL QUERY WHERE query_id = '$W_ID' SYNC" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true wait "$W_PID" 2> /dev/null || true fi rm -f "$W_ERR" "$C_ERR" } trap cleanup EXIT $CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT --query_id "$W_ID" --query "SELECT count() FROM numbers(10000000000) WHERE cityHash64(number) NOT IN (SELECT cityHash64(s) FROM perf_cpu_scheduling_set) SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_mixed_io', max_threads = 1, max_local_read_bandwidth = 1000000, max_read_buffer_size_local_fs = 4096, local_filesystem_read_method = 'read'" > /dev/null 2> "$W_ERR" & W_PID=$! until [ "$($CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT --query "SELECT count() FROM system.processes WHERE query_id = '$W_ID' AND read_rows > 18500")" = 1 ]; do kill -0 "$W_PID" done $CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT --print-profile-events --profile-events-delay-ms=-1 --query "SELECT count() FROM numbers(400000000) WHERE cityHash64(number) % 3 = 0 SETTINGS workload = 'perf_cpu_scheduling_mixed_cpu', max_threads = 1" > /dev/null 2> "$C_ERR" || { cat "$C_ERR" >&2; exit 1; } [ "$($CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT --query "KILL QUERY WHERE query_id = '$W_ID' SYNC FORMAT TSV" | wc -l)" = 1 ] if ! wait "$W_PID"; then grep -q QUERY_WAS_CANCELLED "$W_ERR"; fi W_PID="" awk '/ ConcurrencyControlWaitMicroseconds: / { s += $(NF - 1) } END { exit !(s >= 20000) }' "$C_ERR" || { echo 'workload_cpu_scheduling: the CPU query did not wait for the slot it shares with the neighbour' >&2; exit 1; }
